questions: For each i, are we to compute the maximum possible GCD over all subsets of size K that include A_i, or the GCD of a specific subset (e.g., the K elements with the largest GCD)?
When choosing K elements that include A_i, must the choice be contiguous in the sequence, or can it be any K elements from anywhere in the sequence?
If multiple subsets yield the same GCD, is any output acceptable, or must we output a specific one (e.g., the maximum GCD)?
Should the output be N integers, one for each i, each on a separate line, or in a single line space-separated?
Are we allowed to choose the same element multiple times if its value repeats at different indices, or must all chosen indices be distinct?
If K = 1, does the GCD of a single element equal the element itself, or is there a special case?
Is the GCD defined as a positive integer even if some chosen elements are zero (though constraints say A_i >= 1)?
For each i, if no subset of size K includes A_i (e.g., if K > N), what should be output? But constraints ensure K ≤ N.
